summary: The Open Metaverse Interoperability Group's glTF extensions are a public collection of draft add-ons to the Khronos glTF 2.0 asset format, aimed at features that virtual worlds need and the base format lacks. At the pinned commit the repository holds thirteen of the group's own extensions (rigid-body physics with shapes, joints and gravity volumes; four vehicle parts; seats and spawn points for characters; a sky and environment-light definition; and two audio codec add-ons) plus the text of the Khronos positional audio extension, which has since graduated to Khronos. It covers world-level physics and character placement well, in a form several game engines can already map onto their own systems. It leaves nearly everything else to others: mesh, texture and material encoding stay with glTF itself, and networking, identity, capture, sensing and delivery belong to other standards. Traps for a standards audience: no extension has passed the group's second maturity stage, so none is ratified, and most entries in the repository's own support table are marked unsupported; the physics extensions depend on each other and do nothing alone; and the proposals for world links and for character personality are archived, not current.

coverage.note: Positional emitters with distance models and sound cones, and global emitters for ambient audio, are specified in the audio emitter text kept in this repository, which has since graduated to Khronos; two OMI add-ons supply Opus and Ogg Vorbis as source formats.

sources.title: OMI_physics_shape README (commit 4f1fe73)

sources.title: OMI_physics_joint README (commit 4f1fe73)

coverage.note: Physics quantities are stated in metric units: mass in kilograms, offsets in meters and velocity in meters per second. Missing: any asset-wide scale rule beyond what glTF itself says.
